entities.summary: Abdeslam Ahizoune is a Moroccan businessman. He was the chairman of the management board of Maroc Telecom from 2001 to February 2025, when he was replaced by Mohamed Benchaaboun. He was also its former chief executive officer, the main Moroccan telecommunications company.
